name: Community BBQ
description: Bring a dish to share and enjoy grilled food with neighbors. Grill and charcoal provided.

name: Neighborhood Cleanup
description: Help keep our neighborhood beautiful. Bags and gloves provided. Meet at the park entrance.

name: Board Game Night
description: Bring your favorite board games or try something new. Snacks welcome!

name: Trail Run Group
description: Casual group run on local trails. All paces welcome. We regroup at every mile.

name: Community Potluck Dinner
description: Monthly potluck dinner. Bring a dish that serves 8 and a serving utensil.

name: Bike Repair Workshop
description: Learn basic bike maintenance: flat tire repair, brake adjustment, and chain care. Bring your bike!

name: Book Club Meeting
description: This month we're reading a contemporary fiction title. Check the community board for the current selection.

name: Morning Yoga in the Park
description: Gentle yoga session suitable for all levels. Bring your own mat and water bottle.

name: Movie Night Under the Stars
description: Outdoor movie screening. Bring blankets and lawn chairs. Popcorn provided!

name: Intro to Woodworking
description: Learn to use basic woodworking tools and build a small shelf. All materials provided.

name: Kids Art Hour
description: Drop-in art session for kids ages 4-10. Paint, clay, and craft supplies provided.

name: Pickup Basketball
description: Casual pickup basketball game. All skill levels welcome. We'll split into teams.

name: Community Garden Workday
description: Help plant, weed, and maintain the community garden. Tools and gloves provided.

name: Knitting Circle
description: Bring your knitting or crochet project. Beginners welcome — we have extra needles and yarn.

name: Neighborhood Walking Tour
description: Explore the history and architecture of our neighborhood with a local historian.

name: Taco Tuesday Meetup
description: Weekly taco night at a local restaurant. Great way to meet neighbors in a casual setting.

name: Bicycle Group Ride
description: Leisurely 10-mile group ride through the neighborhood. Helmets required.

name: Craft Beer Tasting
description: Sample local craft beers and learn about the brewing process from the brewmaster.

name: Sewing Basics Workshop
description: Learn to thread a machine, sew straight lines, and make a simple tote bag.

name: Saturday Morning Farmers Market Walk
description: Meet up and walk the farmers market together. We'll share tips on seasonal produce.

name: Dog Walk Meetup
description: Bring your pup for a group walk around the park. Treats and water provided for the dogs.

name: Spanish Conversation Hour
description: Practice your Spanish in a friendly, no-pressure setting. All levels welcome.

name: Trivia Night
description: Test your knowledge in teams of 4. Prizes for the top team. Snacks provided.

name: Photography Walk
description: Explore the neighborhood through your camera lens. Bring any camera or phone.

name: Meditation Session
description: Guided meditation for stress relief. No experience needed. Bring a cushion if you have one.

name: Pizza Making Party
description: Make your own pizza from scratch. Dough, sauce, and toppings provided. Bring your appetite.

name: Volleyball in the Park
description: Casual volleyball game. We have a net and ball. All skill levels welcome.

name: Home Brewing Intro
description: Learn the basics of home brewing beer. We'll brew a batch together from grain to fermenter.

name: Storytelling Night
description: Share a 5-minute true story from your life. No preparation needed — just come and listen or share.

name: Kids Soccer Practice
description: Informal soccer practice for kids ages 6-12. We'll work on dribbling, passing, and small games.

name: Acoustic Jam Session
description: Bring your guitar, ukulele, or any acoustic instrument. All levels welcome.

name: CPR & First Aid Training
description: Learn life-saving CPR and basic first aid skills. Certificate provided upon completion.

name: Nature Sketching Walk
description: Bring a sketchbook and pencils for a guided nature drawing walk. Tips provided for beginners.

name: Potting and Planting Workshop
description: Learn to repot houseplants and propagate cuttings. Pots, soil, and starter plants provided.

name: Sunrise Hike
description: Early morning hike to catch the sunrise. Moderate difficulty, about 3 miles round trip.

name: Improv Comedy Workshop
description: Try improv comedy in a supportive environment. No experience needed — just a willingness to laugh.

name: Wine and Cheese Social
description: Bring a bottle of wine or a cheese to share. We'll do informal tastings and pairings.

name: Community Swap Meet
description: Bring items you no longer need and swap with neighbors. Clothing, books, toys, and household items.

name: Intro to Birdwatching
description: Learn to identify local birds by sight and sound. Binoculars available to borrow.

name: Dance Fitness Class
description: High-energy dance workout set to fun music. No dance experience needed.

name: Friday Coffee Chat
description: Casual Friday morning coffee meetup. Get to know your neighbors over a cup.

name: Beginner Running Club
description: Couch-to-5K style group runs. We go at the slowest person's pace. No one left behind.

name: Community Talent Show
description: Share your talent — singing, comedy, magic, or anything else. All ages welcome.

name: Outdoor Painting Class
description: Plein air painting session. Easels and basic supplies provided. Bring your own paints if you have them.

name: Tech Help Desk
description: Bring your phone, tablet, or laptop for free tech support from neighborhood volunteers.

name: Scrabble Tournament
description: Friendly Scrabble tournament. Boards provided. Prizes for top three finishers.

name: Kickball Game
description: Old-school kickball game for adults. We'll divide into teams. Just show up and play!

name: Kombucha Brewing Workshop
description: Learn to brew your own kombucha at home. Take home a SCOBY and starter kit.

name: Night Sky Stargazing
description: Telescope viewing of planets, constellations, and deep sky objects. Red flashlights only.

name: Cookbook Club
description: Each month we pick a cookbook and everyone makes a recipe from it to share.

name: Free Clothing Swap
description: Bring clean clothes you no longer wear and take home new-to-you pieces. All sizes welcome.

name: Guided Nature Walk
description: Learn about native plants, trees, and wildlife on a guided walk with a local naturalist.

name: Salsa Dancing Lesson
description: Beginner salsa lesson. No partner needed — we rotate. Wear comfortable shoes.

name: Paper Airplane Contest
description: Design and fly paper airplanes for distance and accuracy. Great for families!

name: Sourdough Bread Workshop
description: Learn to make and maintain a sourdough starter and bake your first loaf. Starter provided.

name: Frisbee Golf Outing
description: Casual disc golf round on the local course. Discs available to borrow.

name: Resume Writing Help
description: Get feedback on your resume from experienced professionals. Bring a printed copy.

name: Candle Making Workshop
description: Make your own soy candles with essential oils. All materials provided. Take home two candles.

name: Community Mural Painting
description: Help paint a community mural on the park wall. No art experience needed — just enthusiasm.

name: Brunch Meetup
description: Sunday brunch at a local spot. RSVP so we can reserve a big enough table.

name: Fishing at the Lake
description: Casual fishing outing. Bring your own gear or borrow from the group. Catch and release.

name: Origami Workshop
description: Learn to fold paper into animals, flowers, and boxes. Paper and instructions provided.

name: Outdoor Boot Camp
description: High-intensity interval training in the park. All fitness levels can modify exercises.

name: Neighborhood Watch Meeting
description: Monthly safety meeting. Discuss local concerns and hear from the community officer.

name: Karaoke Night
description: Sing your heart out! Song book has hundreds of options. No judgment, just fun.

name: Watercolor Painting for Beginners
description: Learn basic watercolor techniques. Paint, brushes, and paper provided.

name: Chess in the Park
description: Bring your chess set or use ours. Open play, all skill levels. Tips from experienced players.

name: Financial Literacy Workshop
description: Learn budgeting basics, saving strategies, and intro to investing. Free handouts.

name: Soup Kitchen Volunteer Day
description: Help prepare and serve meals at the local soup kitchen. Aprons provided.

name: Open Mic Poetry Night
description: Read your original poems or favorite works. Supportive audience guaranteed.

name: Tai Chi in the Park
description: Gentle tai chi session for balance and relaxation. Suitable for all ages and abilities.

name: Car Maintenance Basics
description: Learn to check oil, change a tire, and jump a battery. Bring your car if you want hands-on practice.

name: Kids Science Experiments
description: Fun, safe science experiments for kids ages 5-12. Volcanoes, slime, and more!

name: Pub Quiz
description: Team trivia at the local pub. Form teams of 3-5. Bragging rights on the line.

name: Community Composting Workshop
description: Learn how to start and maintain a compost bin at home. Free compost starter kits.

name: Badminton in the Park
description: Casual badminton games. We have nets, rackets, and birdies. Just show up.

name: DIY Home Repair Clinic
description: Learn to fix a leaky faucet, patch drywall, and unclog a drain. Tools and demo materials provided.

name: Sunset Paddleboard Session
description: Relaxing evening paddleboarding. Boards available to borrow. Must be a confident swimmer.

name: Neighborhood Bingo Night
description: Classic bingo with small prizes. Cards and daubers provided. Snacks available.

name: Trail Maintenance Volunteer Day
description: Help clear and maintain local hiking trails. Tools provided. Wear sturdy shoes.

name: Coffee Roasting Demo
description: Watch a live coffee roasting demonstration and taste freshly roasted beans from different origins.

name: Family Game Day
description: Board games, card games, and lawn games for the whole family. Something for every age.

name: Rock Climbing Intro
description: Try indoor rock climbing with experienced belayers. Shoes and harness provided.

name: Holiday Cookie Exchange
description: Bake a batch of your favorite cookies and swap with others. Bring containers to take home.

name: Creek Cleanup
description: Help remove trash and debris from the local creek. Waders, bags, and grabbers provided.

name: Introduction to Beekeeping
description: Learn about bee biology, hive setup, and honey harvesting. Protective gear provided for the demo.

name: Neighborhood Block Party
description: Annual block party with food, music, and games. Bring a side dish to share.

name: Coding for Kids
description: Introduction to Scratch programming for ages 8-14. Laptops provided.

name: Foraging Walk
description: Identify edible plants and mushrooms on a guided foraging walk. Samples to taste.

name: Monthly Happy Hour
description: Casual after-work meetup at a neighborhood bar. First round of appetizers on us.

name: Pottery Workshop
description: Hand-build a bowl or mug from clay. Pieces will be fired and ready for pickup in two weeks.

name: Pickup Soccer
description: Informal soccer game in the park. All ages and skill levels. We bring cones for goals.

name: Gratitude Circle
description: Share what you're grateful for in a supportive group setting. Tea and light snacks provided.

name: Bike-to-Work Prep Workshop
description: Plan your bike commute route, learn road safety, and get a free bike tune-up.

name: Ice Cream Social
description: Free ice cream sundae bar for the whole neighborhood. Toppings galore!

name: Herb Garden Workshop
description: Start your own herb garden. Learn about soil, sunlight, and watering. Take home a starter pot.

name: Capture the Flag
description: Big group game of capture the flag in the park. For ages 10 and up. Flags provided.

name: Language Exchange Meetup
description: Practice any language with native speakers. Name tags indicate languages offered and sought.

name: Slack-line and Hammock Hangout
description: Chill afternoon with slacklines and hammocks in the park. We have extras to share.

name: Monthly New Neighbor Welcome
description: Welcome new community members with coffee, introductions, and a neighborhood info packet.
